stem: Which description best identifies the action-reaction pair between the bird and the fence post?

options.label: F
options.text:
Action: The force of the bird on the wires
Reaction: The force of the wires on the fence post

options.label: G
options.text:
Action: The force of the wires on the fence post
Reaction: The force of the fence post on the bird

options.label: H
options.text:
Action: The force of the fence post on the bird
Reaction: The force of the bird on the wires

options.label: J
options.text:
Action: The force of the bird on the fence post
Reaction: The force of the fence post on the bird

visual_elements: A black-and-white photograph of a bird perched on top of a square fence post with wire fences attached to the post.
